title: Use proven root potential bounds during appearance resolution
description: Performance follow-up under TSK-0008. AppearanceResolveBurst already performs per-operation proof-based culling, while DensityGrid also has a root potential-envelope fast path. Reuse the same root-level potential-bounds contract for per-vertex appearance candidate resolution so vertices provably outside a program's potential influence never enter its operation walk. This must be validated against the exact uncullled appearance resolver before enabling because the envelope semantics must remain conservative for all SDF primitives, transforms, symmetry, smooth unions, nested unions, and fallback cases.
